children: The new U.S. export controls pose the greatest risks to Malaysia's AI data center and GPU infrastructure segments, CIMB Securities analyst Mohd Shanaz Noor Azam says. Tighter licensing requirements could delay chip procurement, project rollouts and investment decisions, he says. Semiconductor test-equipment and automation companies may face indirect risks from deferred orders. Traditional outsourced semiconductor assembly and testing, electronics manufacturing services and automotive-related players should see limited direct impact. The analyst expects near-term earnings impact on Malaysian semiconductor players. CIMB maintains an overweight rating on the Malaysian tech sector, names Vitrox and Malaysian Pacific Industries as its most preferred, citing their order visibility and semiconductor growth opportunities. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
